Battle of Ali Masjid (1839)
The battle of Ali masjid (1839) was the sikh march to kabul emrging the sikhs victorius. The sikhs made sure that not one religious embilment was hurt or damaged. Thi was the desire of Maharaja Ranjit singh's, after the death of Hari singh nalwa at the battle of jamrud.The battle resulted in sikh voctory and shah shuja's throne of kabul was restoread and replaced by the sikhs. this ended in 1843 whilst in the reign of maharaja Sher singh where the afghans took over kabul from the sikhs.
Battle of Ali masjid (1839)
part of the Afghan-Sikh war
Date: 27 july 1839
location: Kabul Afghanistan
Result: Sikh victory
